disposition.note: Call type, post-budget read and check codes are set in the P10 contract, not this story.

disposition.change: Declare the step submit and link operations under /api/recovery/agent/v1 with fixed member types; set refusals 401, 403, 409, 422, 503 with 409 for a RUNNING step key or a run already holding a record; state the record reference as UUID with rwb-decision read-back.

BR2, BR4, BR5 and BR7 already carry LOV-DECISION code, actions keys, final_call and recommendation; code settlement remains a reference-data step.
